description.it: Le copie ritirate dalla collezione tra le due date, con il motivo e il valore: l'elenco da allegare al decreto di discarico dell'inventario.
description.en: The copies withdrawn from the collection between the two dates, with the reason and the value: the list to attach to the inventory's discharge decree.

sql: SELECT i.inventory_number AS inventory_number, i.barcode AS barcode, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, i.withdrawn_on AS withdrawn_on, i.withdrawn_reason AS reason, i.origin AS origin, i.value_cents / 100.0 AS value FROM item i JOIN biblio b ON b.id = i.biblio_id WHERE i.status = 'withdrawn' AND i.withdrawn_on BETWEEN :from AND :to ORDER BY i.withdrawn_on, i.inventory_number, i.barcode
